ai_analysis.summary: The post recommends 20 videos for data engineering interview preparation. The listed subjects include an Azure Data Engineer roadmap, Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Sqoop, data storage and modeling comparisons, partitioning and bucketing, SCD types, repartitioning and coalescing, and group-by-key versus reduce-by-key. It provides links and titles only, without technical explanations, examples, or interview answers, and ends with promotion for a Data Engineering Instagram channel and a resource claiming more than 100 interview experiences.
